_README: FORMAT ANCHORS, NOT CONTENT CLAIMS. Every string below is hand-written
English in the exact shape the schema at that call site asks for. They exist
for one reason: core/language_gate.py rejects 85% of the historical exemplar
pool, and a 3B model handed two examples instead of five loses format
stability and starts inventing structure. These hold the shape while a clean
NO FACTS, NO NUMBERS, NO PLACE NAMES. Every specific is an angle-bracket
placeholder — <AXIS>, <INDICATOR>, <STEP>, <N>. A seed exemplar that carried
a real-looking number would be teaching the model to assert it, and the
model cannot tell an example's content from an example's form.
They are rendered with a [seed] marker instead of a timestamp, so nothing
can mistake one for something the system actually thought.

compared against those literals, so an all-English seed would have taught the
model to break the contract. The enum is go|watch|skip now, the consumers go

cycle_plan: {"focus": "<ONE OR TWO WORDS>", "why": "The state of <SUBSYSTEM> makes this the thing worth attending to this cycle.", "watch": ["<INDICATOR>", "<STEP>"], "suspicion": "<WHAT MAY BE WRONG IN MYSELF, OR EMPTY>", "success_test": "By the end of the cycle, <OBSERVABLE CONDITION> will be true."}

{"focus": "<ONE OR TWO WORDS>", "why": "Nothing has changed in <AREA> for several cycles and I do not know whether that is health or a stalled reader.", "watch": ["<INDICATOR>"], "suspicion": "", "success_test": "I will be able to say which of the two it is, from evidence rather than from absence."}

{"focus": "<ONE OR TWO WORDS>", "why": "The previous cycle left <ARTEFACT> untouched, so the steps downstream of it worked on stale input.", "watch": ["<STEP>", "<ARTEFACT>"], "suspicion": "My own plan may be describing work that no step actually performs.", "success_test": "<ARTEFACT> is written this cycle, or the reason it was not is recorded."}
cycle_review: {"success": false, "verdict": "The test I set myself was not met: <CONDITION> did not become true, and the reason was <CAUSE>.", "blind_spot": "My plan assumed <ASSUMPTION> and never checked it.", "carry_forward": "Check <ASSUMPTION> before planning around it again."}

{"success": true, "verdict": "<CONDITION> became true and the evidence for it is in <ARTEFACT>, not in my own account of the cycle.", "blind_spot": "I watched <INDICATOR> and did not notice that <OTHER INDICATOR> moved with it.", "carry_forward": "Those two indicators may not be independent; read them together next time."}

{"success": false, "verdict": "The cycle finished but the step that mattered produced nothing, so the result is a completed cycle and no answer.", "blind_spot": "I treated 'the step ran' as 'the step worked'.", "carry_forward": "A step's own output is the evidence, not its exit."}
constancy: {"expected_regime": "Stable by nature", "why_expected": "<INDICATOR> measures a quantity that changes over years rather than days, so a flat reading over the observed window is the expected behaviour and not a fault.", "healthy": true, "alarm": false, "reading": "The series is flat because the quantity is slow, not because the reader has stopped."}

{"expected_regime": "Should move", "why_expected": "<INDICATOR> on axis <AXIS> is a daily proxy and is expected to vary between readings; an unchanged value across the whole window is more likely a stalled source than a stable world.", "healthy": false, "alarm": true, "reading": "The value has not changed across the observed window, which for this indicator points at a frozen reader rather than a steady quantity."}

{"expected_regime": "Bounded drift", "why_expected": "<INDICATOR> is a cumulative counter, so it only ever rises; what matters is the size of each increment, not the level.", "healthy": true, "alarm": false, "reading": "The increments are within the range this counter usually shows, so nothing here needs attention."}

{"expected_regime": "Unknown", "why_expected": "The material does not say how <INDICATOR> is produced, and without that I cannot tell a stable quantity from a stopped reader.", "healthy": false, "alarm": false, "reading": "There is not enough in the material to judge this series; the gap is in the provenance, not in the numbers."}
constellation: {"relations": ["<INDICATOR A> and <INDICATOR B> should move together and did not, over the same window.", "<INDICATOR C> is flat, which only matters because <INDICATOR D> moved."], "most_telling": "The first, because two indicators that share a source cannot legitimately disagree about direction.", "what_would_change_my_mind": "Evidence that <INDICATOR A> and <INDICATOR B> are drawn from different sources after all."}

{"relations": ["<INDICATOR A> and <INDICATOR B> both stopped changing on the same reading, which is a coincidence only if they have separate readers."], "most_telling": "That they stopped together; a shared stall is a fact about the pipeline, not about the world.", "what_would_change_my_mind": "A record showing the two are read by independent collectors."}

{"relations": ["<INDICATOR A> moved while <INDICATOR B>, which is derived from it, did not."], "most_telling": "A derived value that does not follow its input has stopped being derived from it.", "what_would_change_my_mind": "A lag in the derivation long enough to explain the gap."}
cycle_report: {"opening": "The cycle completed. <N OF M> steps touched the artefact they promise, and the ones that did not are named below. The composite moved within its usual range. Nothing in this cycle required a human.", "decisions": ["Kept <STEP> despite its cost, because the steps after it read what it writes.", "Recorded <OBSERVATION> rather than acting on it, because one cycle is not evidence."], "worry": "<STEP> reports success and touches nothing, so its verdict and its effect disagree.", "closing": "A working cycle with one unresolved question, which is a better outcome than a clean report with no questions in it."}

{"opening": "The cycle finished late and degraded. The model tier that usually answers was unavailable for most of the run, so several steps produced nothing rather than producing something wrong.", "decisions": ["Let the degraded steps degrade instead of retrying them into the ceiling."], "worry": "A degraded step and a successful one look the same in the log unless the reader knows where to check.", "closing": "Not a successful cycle, and the failure is recorded honestly enough to act on."}

{"opening": "An ordinary cycle with nothing unusual in it. Every backbone step ran, the artefacts are fresh, and no threshold was crossed.", "decisions": ["Changed nothing."], "worry": "Several cycles in a row with nothing to report may mean the system is stable, or that it has stopped looking.", "closing": "Successful, and worth checking that the quiet is real."}
mirror_read: {"saw": "The oldest item waiting for a human has been waiting <N> days, and the count of open proposals has not fallen for several cycles.", "worries": "Work is accumulating faster than it is being answered, and nothing in the system slows down when that happens.", "numbers": "<N> open proposals, oldest <N> days, <N> judged calibration points."}

{"saw": "The judge's calibration has fewer resolved points than open predictions, so its accuracy is being reported from a small sample.", "worries": "An accuracy figure computed from few points reads as confidently as one computed from many.", "numbers": "<N> resolved of <N> open predictions."}

{"saw": "Several phase debriefs were rejected for citing no number from their own data.", "worries": "A rejected debrief leaves the phase with no account of itself at all, which is worse than a weak one.", "numbers": "<N> of <N> debriefs rejected."}
phase_debrief: {"what": "The phase completed <N> steps and produced <N> artefacts, the oldest of them <N> minutes old.", "verdict": "OK", "risk": "One of the artefacts is older than the phase itself, so a step downstream may be reading the previous cycle's work.", "do": "Check the timestamp of <ARTEFACT> against the cycle's start before trusting anything derived from it."}

{"what": "The phase ran to the end but <N> of its steps touched none of the files they declare.", "verdict": "DEGRADED", "risk": "The phase reports success while part of its output is stale, and the steps after it cannot tell.", "do": "Treat <ARTEFACT> as unwritten this cycle and say so in the report."}

{"what": "The phase was cut short: the model tier it depends on returned nothing within the budget.", "verdict": "DEGRADED", "risk": "No judgement was produced for this phase, and an absent judgement can be mistaken for an untroubled one.", "do": "Record the absence explicitly rather than leaving the phase without a line."}

{"action": "rollback", "step": "<STEP>", "why": "<STEP> ran before <ARTEFACT> was written, so it scored data that has since been replaced.", "expect": "The score changes, or it does not and I learn the input did not matter.", "wants": "To recompute the two steps together rather than one of them."}

{"action": "forward", "step": "", "why": "The step I would go back to has already been recomputed once this cycle, and a second return would be me arguing with myself.", "expect": "", "wants": "A way to record the doubt without spending the cycle on it."}

Record that this is a designed exit so the next reader does not diagnose it again."}

step_stance: {"prev_ok": true, "prev_note": "<STEP> wrote the artefact it promises and the file is fresh.", "stance": "go", "expect": "<STEP> reads what the previous step wrote and produces <ARTEFACT>.", "serves_goal": "It supplies the measurement the composite is computed from."}

{"prev_ok": false, "prev_note": "<STEP> returned without error and touched none of the files it declares.", "stance": "watch", "expect": "This step reads that artefact, so it may be working on stale input.", "serves_goal": "It serves the goal only if its input belongs to this cycle; otherwise it is repeating yesterday."}

{"prev_ok": true, "prev_note": "<STEP> completed and its output is on disk.", "stance": "skip", "expect": "Nothing downstream is waiting for what this step produces, and the model tier it needs is unavailable.", "serves_goal": "Skipping it costs nothing this cycle and leaves budget for the steps that do serve it."}

{"stance": "go", "expect": "<STEP> runs for the first time this cycle and writes <ARTEFACT>.", "serves_goal": "It is the first measurement of the axis, so everything downstream of it is empty without it."}

{"stance": "watch", "expect": "<STEP> is the slowest step of the cycle and has been cut off at its budget before.", "serves_goal": "It serves the goal, but not at any price; if it degrades again that is worth recording rather than retrying."}
